maria: FYI - onboarding caught a blocker in the starter-kit when using fn-calls + JSON mode. JS SDK fails schema validation, Python passes. stack trace below.

dan: Can you paste the error and the exact config you used?

maria: Error: JSON parse failed: Unexpected token "

Attached snippet: ```js
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'gpt-redwood-1',
  messages,
  function_call: { name: 'upsert_user' },
  json_mode: 'strict',
});
```

ashley: Ran into the same while walking a new hire through the starter kit. Repro steps: `npm init` -> install `@redwood/sdk-js` -> run `examples/starter-kit/run.sh`. Worked in py example though.

dan: Hmm. Do you have the function schema you passed?

maria: Schema we use: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string" },
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  },
  "required": ["user_id"]
}
```

ashley: The JS error shows this payload hitting the validator: `{"user_id":"123","metadata":""}` - metadata is an empty string, which fails because we expect object.

simon: That payload looks like a retry/transform artifact. JS SDK retry wrapper sometimes stringifies empty metadata when streaming+retries happen. We saw similar for embeddings.

dan: I think the core parity issue is the JS helper that coerces partial tool responses into strings before final parse. Python's helper buffers the chunks and merges typed objects.

maria: Is there a quick workaround for new hires so starter-kit isn't blocked?

dan: For now set `json_mode: 'lenient'` or add `metadata: {}` as default in the schema. Also you can set env `RW_SDK_DISABLE_CLIENT_RETRY=true` to avoid the interim stringification. Not ideal but unblock.

ashley: Will add a note to the sample app README with the env workaround and a temporary schema tip.

simon: I'll open a fix PR to make JS helper buffer and rehydrate objects like Python. Will include unit tests that simulate streaming retries.

dan: OK I'll review. Targeting a patch release (0.12.x) this week. We should also add an integration test in the starter-kit CI that exercises fn-calls + json_mode strict.

maria: Thanks. Can we also add a quick debug log in the SDK when a retry injects text so users see a warning instead of silent schema fail?

dan: Good call. I'll add a `logger.warn` with a link to docs.

devex-bot: Deploy task created: devex/js-sdk#458 -> staging.

maria: Sweet. Appreciate the fast turnaround :raised_hands:

ashley: I'll update onboarding checklist and ping new hires.

simon: PR up in ~2h.

dan: Marking this one as a devex bug and tracking in the SDK parity epic.

maria: Closing loop once PR is in and starter-kit CI passes. :thumbsup:
